name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y build-essential; if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo xargs apt-get install -y < packages.txt; fi; python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel; if [ -f requirements-app.txt ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-app.txt; fi; .venv/bin/python -c 'from preprocessing import ensure_nltk_data; print("NLTK missing:", ensure_nltk_data())' || true; .venv/bin/python verify_setup.py || true; echo 'Setup finished - see the verification report above'
